items.title: Why Netflix Uses Python Over AI Agents
items.summary:
In episode 947 of the SuperDataScience podcast, Jeffrey Li discusses a controversial tweet where he claimed AI agents are effectively just Python scripts. He explains that while he supports building agents to automate tasks, the wide search space of Large Language Models (LLMs) often makes them unreliable for specific tasks. He argues that when users require deterministic outcomes, the solution often reverts to a standard Python script rather than a complex AI agent.

Additional materials: https://www.superdatascience.com/947

items.title: Instant vs Thinking vs Auto… explained in 30 seconds
items.summary:
Most people think Instant, Thinking, and Auto are “different models” in ChatGPT… but here’s the real secret: it’s the same brain, just thinking at different speeds.

Instant mode is like asking your friend for the quickest possible answer. Thinking mode is asking them to take a breath and double-check their reasoning. Auto is just… smart enough to pick the right approach for you.

Once you understand that, the weird differences in answer quality suddenly make sense.

And honestly, I love how this shows something most users still miss: performance isn’t only about model size. It’s about how much thinking time we allocate.

I’m Louis-François, PhD dropout, now CTO and co-founder at Towards AI. Follow me for tomorrow’s no-BS AI roundup 🚀

#chatgpt #openai #aiexplained  #short

items.title: AI Latent Space Surgery: The End of Fine-Tuning?
items.summary:
Orthogonal Subspaces in AI encode ... personality alignment or more entangled complexities by placing additional attention heads on the transformer architecture. 

The evolution of Large Language Models (LLMs) is shifting from the pursuit of general-purpose reasoning to the creation of specialized, coherent agents. Whether for immersive role-playing in open-world environments or empathetic engagement in therapeutic settings, the utility of an AI agent increasingly depends on its ability to maintain a stable, distinct psychological profile.
However, achieving this "personality alignment" without degrading the model’s core intelligence remains one of the field’s most persistent challenges.

All rights w/ author:
The Geometry of Persona: Disentangling Personality
from Reasoning in Large Language Models
Zhixiang Wang
from
Precision and Intelligence Medical Imaging Lab, Beijing Friendship Hospital, Capital Medical University
arXiv:2512.07092

items.title: Will Transformers Take Over Forecasting? Netflix’s Jeff Li Explains the Truth
items.summary:

Jeff also discusses how to run forecasts and trends, and how to read their results. Listen to hear Jeff Li discuss how Spotify became a podcast powerhouse, his startup move.ai, and the tools he uses every day.

Additional materials: https://www.superdatascience.com/947

items.title: Manning Online - All Our Content, All the Time!
items.summary:
What if you could explore any Manning book the moment you need it—whether you’re learning something new, stuck on a problem, or just curious about where tech is heading next?

Manning Online is our subscription program for readers who don’t want to wait for the next book to arrive. You get full access to hundreds of Manning titles, including finished books and those still being written, so you can follow new ideas as they take shape. Topics range from software development and data to AI, cloud, security, and the skills that make working in tech sustainable over the long haul.

Learn more about Manning Online and see if it fits how you learn: https://hubs.ly/Q03XBs-H0
